title: Find the jaunts that are read aloud
items: The Jaunts list has a new Listen row. Tap Narrated to see only the jaunts that are read aloud to you, alongside the group, age and search filters; Clear filters lets it go.
Every narrated jaunt now says Narrated on its card, so you can tell before you start which ones speak.
A Music pill joins it once jaunts have music of their own.
